page.layout: One column of running text. Running head at top, centred. Page number at top right. No margin notes. Small chronological figures stand at the right of the § lines, inside the text block. Catchword at bottom right, gathering signature at bottom centre-left.

main_text.l: §. 2. Anno P. J. 4702. U. C. 742. Sulp. Quirino & M. Valer. Messalâ coss. Jul. 34. Herodis 28 | 25 / 29 | 26
Agrippa in Campaniâ moritur, & Tiberius ejus vi-
duam Juliam dücit uxorem.
Antipater Romæ amicis omnibus Herodis commen-
datus illustris factus est, atque ea peregrinatio illi ad
honorem & primatum regios inter liberos non medio-
criter profuit.
§. 3. Anno P. J. 4703. U. C. 743. P. Fabio Maximo
& Q. Ælio Tuberone coss. Jul. 35. Herodis 29 | 26 / 30 | 27
Antipater, qui Romæ omnibus potiebatur hono-
ribus, hoc unum molestè ferebat, quod non poterat
fratres suos continuis vexare calumniis, veritus ne pa-
rentis animus mutatus se æquiorem præberet erga Ma-
riammes filios: quare absens literis Herodem perpetuo
in eos exacerbavit, quasi de ejus incolumitate sollici-
tus, atque ad tantam eum perduxit iram, ut tandem
inimicus esset adolescentibus.
§. 4. Anno P. J. 4704. U. C. 744. Julio Antonio
& Q. Fabio Africano coss. Jul. 36. Herodis 30 | 27 / 31 | 28 [?]
Herodes unà cum filiis Mariammes, eos accusaturus,
Romam profectus, cum Augustum intelligeret in Galliis
degere, eum Aquileiæ invenit, qui utraque parte au-
dità litis arbiter factus, parentem filiis suis conciliat:
Romam reversi, sibi id haud displicere simulans Anti-
pater, iis gratulatur, atque cum parente etiam rediit
in Patriam.
Statim ac rediit Rex advocatâ in templum concione
orationem habuit, quâ aulicos & cæteros ad concor-
diam hortatur, pronuncians filios post se regnaturos, pri-
mum Antipatrum, deinde ex Mariamme natos

page.notes: Figures after "Herodis" in each § line are stacked pairs (top and bottom line), set small in the text block. Read as 28|25 over 29|26, 29|26 over 30|27, and 30|27 over 31|28; the last pair is doubtful, marked [?]. Long s rendered as s throughout (printed "coff." read as "coss."). Two-word hyphenation "Alle-xandrum" kept as printed. Italic run-in names and dates set as they appear.
